events.title: Doom Keeper - About
events.summary: Steam Next Fest starts tomorrow, and I want to briefly talk about Doom Keeper: what kind of game it is, how its gameplay is built, and which design ideas are at its core. Let me say upfront: I’m not trying to reinvent the wheel or turn action roguelikes upside down. I mostly wanted to experiment with some conventions that personally kept me from fully enjoying games in the genre. 1. events.title: The Doom Keeper Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The Doom Keeper Demo Is Now Available!No keys, no sign-ups.Just press “Download Demo” and try it.The demo is just a small part of the full experience, but it gives a chance to try out the starting characters and get familiar with the basics of the game.We’ll be keeping a close eye on your feedback, so if you run into any bugs, have suggestions, or simply want to share your thoughts, join our Discord and let us know what you think!Your feedback means a lot to us and will help us improve Doom Keep
